summary_bullets: Add Phase 6 ci_monitor.py with CI poll/classify, log collection, fixer waterfall, and GOTO-Rebase signaling
Unit-test bash-parity paths with stub Runner and injected sleep/clock (no shell execution)
Extend config.py with CI monitor tunables and document the module in python/README.md
commit_message:
Implement Phase 6 CI monitor loop in Python

Port ci-wait/ci-status/ci-decide, failed-job classification, log collection with redaction, vendor fix waterfall, local verify, and monitor() driver signals from ship-pr.sh into typed python/ci_monitor.py composing Phase-1 modules only. Add colocated pytest coverage and CI monitor constants in config.py.
